text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of speed humps on Eileen Avenue, between Scarlett Road and Florence Crescent. Staff's assessment indicates the criteria as set out in the updated Traffic Calming Policy has been satisfied. Therefore, speed humps should be installed on Eileen Avenue.
The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Deferred consideration of the item until the October 28, 2024 meeting of the Etobicoke York Community Council.
